import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.Arrays;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int n, k, p;
    static long[] fac = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] ifac = new long[MAXN];
    static int[] f = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] dp = new int[2 * MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        String line = br.readLine();
        String[] parts = line.trim().split("\\s+");
        n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        k = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        p = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);

        int nn = n;
        int maxVal = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                    if (((n >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                        t <<= 1;
                        t |= (i >> j) & 1;
                    }
                }
                f[t] = i;
                nn = Math.max(nn, t);
                maxVal = Math.max(maxVal, t);
            }
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            long res = fpow(k, n, p);
            out.println(res);
            out.flush();
            out.close();
            return;
        }

        // Precompute factorials and inverse factorials
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            fac[i] = mult(fac[i - 1], i, p);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p);
        }

        int size = 1;
        while (size <= maxVal) size <<= 1;

        long[] a = new long[size];
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxVal; i++) {
            a[i] = ifac[f[i]];
        }

        long res = fpow(k, n, p);
        a = subsetPowConvol(a, k, p, size);

        long tmp = mult(a[nn], fac[n], p);
        res = sub(res, tmp, p);
        out.println(res);
        out.flush();
        out.close();
    }

    static long fpow(long base, int exp, int mod) {
        long res = 1;
        long cur = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) != 0) {
                res = mult(res, cur, mod);
            }
            cur = mult(cur, cur, mod);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long mult(long a, long b, int mod) {
        return (a * b) % mod;
    }

    static long inv(long a, int mod) {
        return fpow(a, mod - 2, mod);
    }

    static long sub(long a, long b, int mod) {
        long res = a - b;
        if (res < 0) res += mod;
        return res;
    }

    static long[] subsetPowConvol(long[] a, int k, int p, int n) {
        int logn = 19;
        int[][] fa = new int[logn][n];
        int[][] fc = new int[logn][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int bitcount = Integer.bitCount(j);
                if (bitcount == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = (j < a.length) ? (int) a[j] : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            transform(fa[i], n, p, false);
        }

        int[] resIndices = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int[] va = new int[logn];
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                va[j] = fa[j][i];
            }
            int[] vaPow = powConvol(va, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = vaPow[j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            transform(fc[i], n, p, true);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    if (j < a.length) {
                        a[j] = fc[i][j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return a;
    }

    static void transform(int[] a, int n, int p, boolean invert) {
        int log = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < log; i++) {
            int bitMask = 1 << i;
            for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                if (((m & bitMask) != 0)) {
                    int m2 = m ^ bitMask;
                    int u = a[m];
                    int v = a[m2];
                    if (!invert) {
                        a[m] = (u + v) % p;
                    } else {
                        a[m] = (u - v + p) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] powConvol(int[] a, int k, int p, int n) {
        if (k == 1) {
            return a;
        } else if ((k & 1) != 0) {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k - 1, p, n);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= n - i - 1; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int) ((res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * a[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k >> 1, p, n);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= n - i - 1; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int) ((res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * r[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }
}
